scope: Synthetic near-maximum workflow report, after missing-glyph protection. No model calls or external network. Not an account snapshot or a hosted capacity benchmark.
reproduce: cd backend && node --import tsx scripts/report-stress.mts maximum
limits: One active PDF worker, two waiting snapshots, 30-second overall deadline. The 384 MB V8 worker-heap limit does not cap native buffers or whole-process RSS. Saved account snapshots have a separate 2 MB limit. Single-run latency and memory vary with hardware and load.
